name: Antora
description: Antora is a multi-repository documentation site generator for AsciiDoc content stored in git, built on Asciidoctor.js.
notes: Antora reads only AsciiDoc from git content sources. The benchmark posts are the canonical markdown; a local extension (ssgberk-md-adapter.js) converts them to AsciiDoc in memory inside the single Antora process and generates the index page. The UI bundle is a minimal local zip built in the image.
